Claim 28 / 111 Misleading
"And unlike the $2-trillion tax cut passed in the previous administration that benefitted the top 1 percent of Americans, the American Rescue Plan helped working people—and left no one behind."
Reconciled judgment 2 of 2 seats agree

Model reasoning — Hydramind-pca Pca

The underlying contrast is real—TCJA (~$1.9T, E7) skewed largest share to the top 1% (E2, E5, E9) while ARP targeted working families and cut poverty sharply (E1, E10)—but 'benefitted the top 1%' cherry-picks a cut that actually spanned all income groups (E9) and 'left no one behind' is hyperbole, spinning true facts rather than stating them accurately.
